calculate_elastic_tensor: run calculate_elasticity to compute the elastic tensor from an ASE Atoms object and calculator
compute_bulk_modulus: run calculate_elasticity to compute the bulk modulus using VRH averaging on a crystal structure
compute_shear_modulus: run calculate_elasticity to compute the shear modulus using VRH averaging on a crystal structure
run_elasticity_with_custom_strains: run calculate_elasticity with custom norm_strains and shear_strains sequences for a material
run_elasticity_without_relaxation: run calculate_elasticity with relax_initial and relax_strained set to False to skip relaxation
